title: Daily JGB Yield Table – April 10, 2026
abstract: A daily compilation of Japanese government bond yields across standard maturities, sourced from public market data.
body:
## Daily JGB Yield Table – April 10, 2026

On April 10, 2026, the following yields for Japanese government bonds (JGBs) were recorded at the close of trading in Tokyo. Data is sourced from the Japan Bond Trading Co. and the Ministry of Finance Japan. Yields are expressed in percent per annum.

## Yield Curve Overview

The yield curve for JGBs on April 10, 2026, showed the following levels. The 2-year JGB yield closed at 0.185 percent. The 5-year JGB yield closed at 0.395 percent. The 10-year JGB yield closed at 0.785 percent. The 20-year JGB yield closed at 1.320 percent. The 30-year JGB yield closed at 1.650 percent. The 40-year JGB yield closed at 1.850 percent. These figures represent the mid-market rates at 15:00 JST.

## Comparative Data

Compared to the previous trading day, April 9, 2026, the 2-year yield was unchanged. The 5-year yield decreased by 0.005 percentage points. The 10-year yield increased by 0.010 percentage points. The 20-year yield increased by 0.015 percentage points. The 30-year yield increased by 0.020 percentage points. The 40-year yield increased by 0.020 percentage points. The Bank of Japan (BoJ) did not conduct any unscheduled bond-buying operations on April 10, 2026.

## Market Activity

Trading volume for 10-year JGB futures on the Osaka Exchange was 32,456 contracts. The open interest for the June 2026 contract stood at 145,678 contracts. The Tokyo Stock Exchange reported no significant disruptions in the JGB market. The BoJ's Policy Board meeting minutes for March 2026 were released on April 10, 2026, at 08:50 JST. The minutes indicated that board members discussed the yield curve control framework. No policy changes were announced.

## International Context

On April 10, 2026, the yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note was 3.450 percent. The yield on the 10-year German Bund was 2.100 percent. The yield on the 10-year U.K. Gilt was 3.800 percent. The spread between the 10-year JGB and the 10-year U.S. Treasury note was 266.5 basis points. The spread between the 10-year JGB and the 10-year German Bund was 131.5 basis points. These international yields are sourced from respective central bank and treasury publications.

## Upcoming Auctions

The Ministry of Finance Japan announced the following upcoming JGB auctions. On April 14, 2026, a 5-year JGB auction will be held. On April 16, 2026, a 20-year JGB auction will be held. On April 20, 2026, a 2-year JGB auction will be held. On April 22, 2026, a 10-year JGB auction will be held. On April 24, 2026, a 40-year JGB auction will be held. The Ministry of Finance Japan also stated that the auction for the 30-year JGB originally scheduled for April 18, 2026, has been rescheduled to April 25, 2026. No reason was provided for the rescheduling.

## Additional Notes

The BoJ's next monetary policy meeting is scheduled for April 27-28, 2026. The BoJ's current policy rate is -0.100 percent. The BoJ's ETF purchase program remains unchanged. The BoJ's JGB purchase amounts for April 2026 are as follows: 1-3 year bonds: 475 billion yen per operation; 3-5 year bonds: 450 billion yen per operation; 5-10 year bonds: 425 billion yen per operation; 10-25 year bonds: 350 billion yen per operation; 25-40 year bonds: 150 billion yen per operation. These amounts are subject to change based on market conditions.

The following table summarizes the yields for April 10, 2026, along with the previous day's yields and the change in basis points.

| Maturity | Yield (%) | Previous Yield (%) | Change (bp) |
|----------|-----------|-------------------|-------------|
| 2-year   | 0.185     | 0.185             | 0           |
| 5-year   | 0.395     | 0.400             | -0.5        |
| 10-year  | 0.785     | 0.775             | +1.0        |
| 20-year  | 1.320     | 1.305             | +1.5        |
| 30-year  | 1.650     | 1.630             | +2.0        |
| 40-year  | 1.850     | 1.830             | +2.0        |

All yields are rounded to three decimal places. Basis point changes are calculated from unrounded figures. Data is subject to revision by the source.

## Sources

Japan Bond Trading Co., Ministry of Finance Japan, Bank of Japan, Osaka Exchange, U.S. Department of the Treasury, German Federal Ministry of Finance, U.K. Debt Management Office. All data retrieved on April 10, 2026, at 16:00 JST. This report is for informational purposes only and does not constitute investment advice.
